Chloe Bennett  
Tel Aviv, Israel | +972 54 321 6543 | chloe.bennett@nexaflo.com  

A seasoned backend engineer with 14 years of experience shaping scalable SaaS architectures, driven by pragmatic solutions and measurable outcomes. Specialized in cloud-native systems, distributed infrastructure, and high-performance databases. Proven ability to architect and operationalize complex systems while mentoring cross-functional teams.  

**Technical Skills**  
*Linux administration*: Orchestrated containerized environments at ScaleNova Inc., ensuring 99.95% uptime for critical services. Maintained custom Linux-based CI/CD agents for automated testing.  
*Prometheus/Grafana*: Built centralized monitoring dashboards for AetherCorp’s microservices, reducing incident resolution time by 40%. Integrated custom metrics for real-time anomaly detection.  
*Serverless*: Spearheaded migration of NexaFlow’s batch processing workflows to AWS Lambda, cutting infrastructure costs by 35% and improving cold start latency by 60%.  
*CI/CD pipelines*: Designed Jenkins-based pipelines at ScaleNova that reduced deployment cycles from 4 hours to 15 minutes, enabling zero-downtime rollouts for 12+ services.  
*Docker*: Engineered self-service containerization frameworks at AetherCorp, empowering developers to deploy services in under 10 minutes.  
*Go*: Led development of core API services at NexaFlow, achieving 99.9% request success rates with sub-100ms latency under peak loads.  
*Infrastructure as Code*: Automated provisioning for NexaFlow’s Kubernetes clusters using Terraform, reducing manual configuration errors by 75%.  
*Terraform*: Standardized multi-cloud infrastructure templates across 3 AWS accounts, ensuring consistent compliance and reducing onboarding time for new environments.  
*AWS*: Architectured NexaFlow’s cloud infrastructure, integrating auto-scaling, managed databases, and security protocols. Mentored 5+ engineers on best practices.  
*Kubernetes*: Optimized cluster resource allocation at NexaFlow, reducing node costs by 25% while maintaining 99.99% service availability.  
*Microservices architecture*: Redesigned ScaleNova’s monolithic backend into 15+ decoupled services, improving fault isolation and enabling parallel development.  
*PostgreSQL*: Engineered high-availability database clusters at AetherCorp, supporting 500K+ concurrent users with <50ms query latency.  
*Python*: Built internal tooling for NexaFlow’s CI/CD and monitoring pipelines, streamlining workflows for 10+ teams.  
*REST API design*: Architected API gateways for NexaFlow’s SaaS platform, achieving 98% API call success rates with automated rate limiting and logging.
